headline: Recovery when saved projections, portfolio, or budget won't load
notes: If browser storage has unreadable projection, portfolio, or budget data, an amber banner explains what happened instead of silently resetting.
Download a corrupt-backup copy or open Data & backup to import a JSON export before editing that section.

headline: Budget Monthly opening cash hint
notes: Monthly summary flags when permanent Cash has no December year-end actual for opening cash.
The displayed opening balance still uses the existing year-end fallback so the path stays usable.

headline: App version labels and quote refresh hints
notes: Release log and feedback show a real semver from package.json (with build id), not 0.0.0.
When background price refresh fails, a dismissible hint explains why and when prices last updated.
The quote warning clears on the next successful refresh instead of repeating toasts every five minutes.

headline: Guides, feedback privacy & Question type
notes: Feature guides open above header modals without changing the current tab.
Removed section ⓘ hints in favor of Guides; feedback adds Question and clearer privacy copy.
Send bug reports, ideas, and questions from the header — no name, email, or account data.

headline: In-app feedback & release log
notes: Send anonymous bug reports and ideas from the header — no name or email.
Browse past production changes from Release log at the bottom of the sidebar.

headline: Overview: jump from hints to Actuals
notes: Click amber stale or gap hints on Overview to open Portfolio or Savings Actuals for that series and period.

headline: Ticker quotes validated before use
notes: Symbols with missing or bad quotes show a clear warning, including common Yahoo-style fixes.
Projections and portfolios avoid math that depends on unusable quotes until the symbol resolves.

headline: Smarter delete confirmations
notes: Deleting budget lines, portfolios, scenarios, and related items warns when something else still depends on them.

headline: Overview shows History gaps on the chart
notes: With recorded actuals on, Overview lists stale months and gaps so you see what History still needs.

headline: More reliable linked-file saves
notes: Extra tests and a small fix for linked JSON auto-save so periodic writes are less likely to race on unlink.

headline: Quotes refresh for more ticker formats
notes: Auto quote refresh handles class shares and exchange suffixes beyond plain US symbols.

headline: Portfolio chart: edit actions in the table
notes: Edit planned buy/sell actions and opening cash inline on the Portfolio year table.
Year-table popovers stay on screen near viewport edges.

headline: Guides for Projections and Data & backup
notes: In-app Guides now cover the Projections workspace and the Data & backup settings page.

headline: Guides for Portfolio
notes: Feature guides for the Portfolio tab and its chart, actuals, cash, positions, and growth panels.

headline: Guides for Overview, Budget, and History
notes: Feature guides for Overview runway and charts, Budget views, and History completeness.

headline: Guide breadcrumbs
notes: Guide articles use a breadcrumb trail instead of a single back link, so nested topics are easier to follow.

headline: Guides for Savings
notes: Feature guides for the Savings page and its chart, actuals, and projection panels.

headline: Comparables chart hover guide
notes: A horizontal guide line on the comparables path chart makes it easier to read values along a year.

headline: Budget positions sorted by amount
notes: Position tables default to largest amounts first, and the sort choice is remembered.

headline: Budget Sankey label fix
notes: The Total income label on the year Sankey sits centered below the pool bar.

headline: Budget payment months
notes: Income stays on the left; cost lines support Monthly vs selected months for when payments fall.

headline: Comparables search
notes: Scenario search on Comparables tucks behind a search icon so the panel stays uncluttered.

headline: Budget tab (Income / Cost)
notes: The Income / Cost workspace became the Budget tab — income streams and cost positions by year in CHF.
